groups.name: N0n
groups.profile: Data-sale / extortion leak site listed by Ransomware.live since 18 Sep 2026; posts bulk consumer, patient and customer datasets, often first anonymously (“Company #N”) and named later. 101 posts recorded so far in November. Ransomware.live maps it to Valid Accounts (T1078).

groups.name: Vexy Ransomware
groups.profile: Small operation listed by Ransomware.live since 3 Sep 2026; 6 posts recorded in November. Posts are short company profiles without proof samples. No public TTP reporting.

groups.name: Qilin
groups.profile: Golang RaaS active since July 2022; double extortion; consistently one of the most active leak sites in 2026, with education a frequent target. Affiliates reported to use stolen VPN/RDP credentials and BYOVD to evade EDR. Both listings today are name-only.

groups.name: Aoqin
groups.profile: “AOQIN Leaks” site listed by Ransomware.live since 4 Nov 2026; 9 posts so far. Uses publication countdowns. No public TTP reporting yet.

groups.name: Barracuda
groups.profile: Leak site listed by Ransomware.live since 6 Aug 2026 (not the security vendor of the same name). Sells stolen data outright; today’s post lists a $50,000 price.

groups.name: Curious Worm
groups.profile: New leak site, listed by Ransomware.live only since 11 Nov 2026; 10 posts so far. No public profile or TTP reporting yet.

groups.name: Inc Ransom
groups.profile: Prolific RaaS active since July 2023; MITRE G1032. Uses valid accounts and public-facing exploits, exfiltrates with RClone/MEGA/Restic. Many of today’s Ransomware.live Inc records were re-listings already covered in №80.

groups.name: Krybit
groups.profile: RaaS that launched in late March 2026 (80/20 affiliate split; Windows, Linux, ESXi and NAS lockers). Known for a public feud with rival 0APT in which each leaked the other’s operator data.

groups.name: Panzer
groups.profile: Leak site listed by Ransomware.live since 5 Aug 2026; earlier posts focused on Indonesian public-sector and consumer brands. Both its onion sites showed as unavailable to Ransomware.live at the time of this run.

groups.name: SafePay
groups.profile: Emerged September 2024; runs all operations in-house rather than as a RaaS, and claimed more than 300 victims by mid-2025. Reported access via RDP with valid credentials, ShareFinder and WinRAR/7-Zip exfiltration.
